errors.what: Wheel angle is not continuous or consistent across the index. It falls 150 -> 148.22 -> 132.21 while the driver goes 287 -> 317 -> 347 deg (backwards, as expected for an external Geneva). It then reads 164.20 at driver 17 deg, which is a +32 deg jump, and settles back to exactly 150.00 after the step. The wheel should step a full 60 deg (150 -> 90 or 210) per revolution and stay there. Here it returns to 150 every revolution, so it never indexes cumulatively, or the panel wraps wrongly by 60 deg mid-engagement.
Engagement is asymmetric. At driver 17 deg the wheel is still about 14 deg from rest, while at 317 deg it has barely moved, so the index window does not look symmetric about the line of centres.
